articles.headline: Ted Cruz-led committee approves Trump FCC nominee 15-0 as Democrats boycott vote
keyFacts: The Senate Commerce Committee approved FCC nominee Danielle Thumann in a 15-0 vote after all 13 Democrats boycotted the session.
Democrats accused Thumann of providing false testimony regarding her previous work on media-related topics with FCC Chairman Brendan Carr.
Republicans aim to confirm Thumann before Democrats take control of the Senate in January, despite disputes over committee quorum rules.
body: A Senate committee chaired by Ted Cruz (R-Texas) voted today to approve a Federal Communications Commission nominee, despite accusations that the nominee gave false testimony about her work as a legal advisor for FCC Chairman Brendan Carr. Democrats attempted to prevent a quorum by not showing up, but Cruz proceeded with a Republican-only vote.

All 15 Republicans on the Senate Commerce Committee voted to approve Trump nominee Danielle Thumann, while the committee’s 13 Democrats were absent. “We’re going to be doing our job today, even if the Democrats refuse to show up to do theirs,” Cruz said at today’s hearing.
Nominees are vetted in committees first, and then seek require majority approval from the Senate. Republicans are hoping to get Thumann confirmed before Democrats take Senate control in January.

Although the Senate Commerce Committee generally requires one minority member to be present for nomination votes, a spokesperson for Cruz said Senate rules allow the nomination to be advanced for a vote in the entire chamber. A spokesperson for Sen. Maria Cantwell (D-Wash.), the top Democrat on the committee, said in response that “since 2005, Commerce Committee rules required that a quorum include one member of the minority for official action on bill, resolution, or nomination.”

Technically, the committee has operated with no rules during Cruz’s chairmanship because Cruz “failed to pass committee rules” for the current session of Congress, Cantwell’s spokesperson said. “Nevertheless, in practice it has operated in line with rules from the last Congress (and this provision, specifically, since 2005), including that a quorum with a member of the minority party must be present for official action on a nomination or legislation. Until today.”
False testimony allegation

At a hearing last week, Thumann said she never worked with Carr on media-related topics, leading to accusations that she provided false testimony. “I have not worked with the chairman on any media-related issues,” Thumann said after Sen. Ben Ray Luján (D-N.M.) asked, “Do you support Chairman Carr’s illegal campaign to remove Jimmy Kimmel from the nation’s airwaves?”

articles.headline: Waymo pauses service in San Francisco after robotaxis get stuck on flooded streets
keyFacts: Waymo temporarily paused its robotaxi service in San Francisco due to vehicles getting stuck on flooded streets.
District 5 Supervisor Bilal Mahmood and the Waymo app confirmed the service interruption following reports of vehicles blocking intersections.
Waymo stated that service will resume once road conditions improve and weather forecasts clear.
body: Waymo pauses service in San Francisco after robotaxis get stuck on flooded streets
This isn’t the first time the company’s robotaxis have caused chaos in the city.

Waymo has temporarily paused its robotaxi service in San Francisco due to issues dealing with flooding on some streets, according to an X post from District 5 Supervisor Bilal Mahmood and a message in the Waymo app. The interruption in service follows several incidents of Waymos blocking intersections because they're seemingly unable (or unwilling) to drive through water.

Riders who want to get picked up are now greeted with a message in the app that says "we're paused for now due to weather" and that service will resume "when road conditions improve and the forecast looks clear." San Francisco is currently dealing with heavy rain and flooding as the region heads into what forecasters expect could be a record El Niño winter.

Ahead of the pause, videos posted on X showed a Waymo stopped in the middle of a flooded crosswalk, forcing cars to drive around it. Another Waymo idled in the middle of a road and instructed its rider to stay inside.
WATCH: Waymo robotaxi gets STUCK in a flooded San Francisco intersection as an atmospheric river swamps the Bay Area
> Waymo paused its Bay Area robotaxi service around 11 AM local time, saying it will return when roads improve
> Downtown SF got about 2.11 inches of rain before... pic.twitter.com/txR939p4Qf
— James Reichert (@_jamesreichert) November 18, 2026
Engadget has asked Waymo to comment on the stalled robotaxis and the issues it's facing with San Francisco's current weather. We'll update this article if we hear back.

Waymo previously paused service in San Francisco in December 2025, when a power outage led to similar instances of robotaxis blocking city streets. The company has also dealt with flooding in the past. In May, Waymo recalled nearly 4,000 vehicles and paused its service after a robotaxi drove into a flooded road in San Antonio. The company issued a software update to address the issue, but later had to pause service in Atlanta when a Waymo drove into a flooded street again.

The fact that the company is dealing with these issues in San Francisco suggests solving this problem might be more complicated than it appears. The pause only affects the city, but it comes just a day after the California DMV restricted Waymo from the state's freeways, prompting the company to pull its robotaxis off freeways in all of its markets.

articles.headline: Mykhailo Mudryk not ruling out Chelsea renaissance as he names three clubs he held talks with before Tottenham loan
keyFacts: Mykhailo Mudryk confirmed he held transfer talks with Brighton, Brentford, and Leeds before joining Tottenham on a season-long loan from Chelsea.
Mudryk remains hopeful of returning to Chelsea next year after manager Xabi Alonso encouraged him to gain regular playing time elsewhere.
The winger alleged that he consumed a banned substance while on international duty due to a lack of security within the Ukrainian national team.
body: Mykhailo Mudryk has revealed he held talks with Brighton, Brentford and Leeds before joining Tottenham from Chelsea.
The 25-year-old sealed a season-long loan deal with Spurs in August in a move that contains an option to buy worth £75million.
Mudryk was shipped off on loan to Spurs from Chelsea after his doping case was resolved Getty
Having not featured for the Blues in a competitive game since December 2024 due to a failed drugs test, Mudryk had been slapped with a four-year ban by FIFA .
But all charges against him were dropped in July , allowing him to instantly resume his football career.
Having featured under new Blues boss Xabi Alonso in pre-season, the west London outfit allowed him to depart in the summer with the Ukrainian seeking regular football.
talkSPORT reported how Leeds were the subject of two failed loan approaches for the pacey winger .
Brentford were another club looking to secure his services.
But in the end, Mudryk elected to reunite with his former Shakhtar Donetsk boss Roberto De Zerbi at Tottenham .
And during his appearance on Ukrainian YouTube channel Guest of Gordon, Mudryk has revealed the Seagulls were another possible destination.
Discussing which clubs were interested in prising him away from Stamford Bridge, he confirmed he held talks with Brighton, Brentford and Leeds.
All three clubs he rejected currently sit above 11th-placed Spurs in the table.
How has Mudryk fared at Tottenham?
As it stands, his switch to north London hasn’t gone to plan, having been limited to just 16 minutes of Premier League football this term.
Mudryk has scored ten goals in 73 games for the Blues across all competitions Getty
Mudryk’s only outing this term has been his cameo off the bench in the 0-0 draw away at Nottingham Forest on September 5, with the forward picking up an ankle knock shortly after in training.
Though he could be available for selection in Spurs’ home tie against Ipswich Town on Saturday.
What has Mudryk said about his Chelsea future?
Despite Spurs having an option to turn his temporary stay into a permanent switch, Mudryk has revealed a return to Chelsea remains in the pipeline.
Commenting on a discussion he had with Alonso before his exit, he claimed that the Spaniard is hopeful of having him in his squad next year
Mudyk said: “[Alonso] told me straight up to my face, ‘You better go and play and get some minutes,’ then come back.
“I am counting on you.”
Mudryk will be hoping to win his place back in Ukraine’s side in the March international break Getty
What has Mudryk said about his doping case?
In a stinging blast towards his home nation, Mudryk has claimed that he felt let down by a lack of support from the Ukrainian FA during his ban.
Having insisted that they ‘offered no help,’ he also stated: “They created more problems than they solved.
“When I needed the help the most, they turned their back.”
And he also believes he consumed the banned substance meldonium while on international duty.
Mudryk remarked: “I had never of heard of a drug like meldonium, it is a drug you can only get in Eastern Europe, it could only have got into my body in Ukraine. There is no such drug in England.”
Before adding: “The Ukrainian national team has absolutely no security system.
“At clubs, when you travel to an away game, there are always people responsible for what happens on the hotel floors and in the team. There are people who keep an eye on it.
“On the Ukrainian national team, we have a nutritionist who hands us pills, every couple of days before games, he brings us a little cup, everyone has to take the pills that are in that cup.”

articles.headline: Set phasers to stun (the contents of my wallet): Magic's Star Trek crossover is one of the good ones
keyFacts: Magic: The Gathering has released a new Star Trek crossover set featuring mechanics based on the franchise's themes of exploration and teamwork.
The set includes specific mechanics like Federation, spacecraft stationing, and Beam Me Up to reflect Star Trek lore and character abilities.
The Star Trek set is available now for both tabletop Magic: The Gathering and the digital Arena platform.
body: I recruited the biggest Star Trek fan I know to help me road test the new Magic: The Gathering set. Right away he was impressed by cards that referenced the Star Trek: Prodigy cartoon and Star Trek Beyond—a third movie in the J. J. Abrams-verse I completely forgot was even made—but if that kind of trainspotting was all it took to make a successful crossover then people would have liked the Spider-Man cards a lot more than they did.

What makes the better Universes Beyond crossovers work is how they bring out the themes of their source material, turning motifs into mechanics that make a set feel like a genuine expression of the thing being adapted rather than just another property being fed into the content machine. Having played some games with the cards, yeah, I think Star Trek works.

I built a blue-green deck around Strange New Worlds, a mechanic that rewards you for having different lands rather than just stacking Islands and Forests. When I played Deep Space Scan I drew a card for each differently named land I had, and those lands also lowered the cost of powering up my Astute Terraformer.

Meanwhile, the Federation mechanic gives bonuses for having different creature types on the table like Vulcan and Klingon and Romulan (though not Borg). With just those two mechanics, the set emphasizes exploration and diversity. You really do want to put together a crew representing multiple species and send them into the final frontier. (There is of course a card called Final Frontier.)

Star Trek also makes use of the spacecraft mechanics introduced in Edge of Eternities, where a ship starts with limited capabilities but has to be stationed by tapping creatures to add charge counters to access its full abilities—like flying and fighting. Lt. Cmdr. Geordi La Forge is a solid combo, doubling the amount of charge counters you add each time and letting you get the Enterprise into the air twice as fast.

There are cards for various different iterations of the Enterprise, but I'm partial to U.S.S. Enterprise-A, Free Spirit, because when you play it you get three red 1/1 officer tokens for free. That makes it faster to station, and after that you've got three disposable officers to chump block with. Which is why they're red.

There's also a Beam Me Up mechanic to bring a card back from the discard pile at the cost of returning a card from the table to your hand, and a cute assimilate mechanic that lets you wipe creatures' existing types then turn them into artifacts under your control for your Borg deck. But what makes the Star Trek cards feel like Star Trek is how much they emphasize teamwork.
Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

The Common Goal card lets two creatures deal damage together, and there's a whole suite of cards that get better when you've got creatures with a total power of 8 attacking as one. Worf, Honor-Bound Warrior, who doubles his own power when he's part of that attack, proved a gamewinner for my red/white deck more than once. The thing that really comes across is Star Trek's utopian ideal of everyone pulling together in a crisis and being better for our differences. It's optimistic, with stars in its eyes, and even a casual Star Trek watcher like me can appreciate that.
Magic: The Gathering's Star Trek set is available now, for both tabletop Magic and Arena.

articles.headline: Dozens of Army soldiers sign up for unique reenlistment incentive to play Grand Theft Auto VI
keyFacts: Forty-three soldiers at Fort Stewart, Georgia, reenlisted in the U.S. Army in exchange for a four-day pass to play Grand Theft Auto VI.
The incentive was offered by the 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion alongside standard reenlistment bonuses to encourage soldiers to continue their service.
The Army stated that the unique perk successfully sparked positive conversations among soldiers regarding their career continuation.
body: The U.S. Army turned to one of the year’s most anticipated video games to get soldiers at Fort Stewart, Georgia, talking about reenlisting.
The offer was a four-day pass to play " Grand Theft Auto VI " when it launches Thursday.
The Army said 43 of the 130 eligible soldiers in the 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion chose the perk when they reenlisted for two to six more years, Task & Purpose first reported.
NBA PLAYER PREDICTS AMERICAN ATHLETES' PERFORMANCES WILL DIP IN NOVEMBER WHILE THEY PLAY GTA

"I’m all campaign. I’m all about the heist," Sgt. Jamire Smith, a combat engineer who signed up for six more years in the Army and took the four-day pass, told Task & Purpose. "I think I have a good 24 hours to waste on it."

Smith said he had been close to leaving the Army before leaders in his company and battalion showed him they still needed his skills. He qualified for a roughly $60,000 reenlistment bonus after training to drive heavy breaching vehicles, the outlet reported.
US ARMY HITS 2026 RECRUITING GOALS FOUR MONTHS EARLY, PETE HEGSETH ANNOUNCES AT WEST POINT COMMENCEMENT

The battalion offered the pass from Aug. 1 through Nov. 14. The Army said the time off came on top of standard reenlistment incentives , which can include cash bonuses or a choice of duty station depending on a soldier’s eligibility and the Army’s needs.

Staff Sgt. Brittany Wolfer, the battalion’s career counselor, called the perk an "eye grabber." She pitched it to her commander after hearing Sgt. Maj. Celeste R. Spencer, a senior Army career counselor , float the idea on TikTok.

Wolfer said the battalion had gone about eight months without a career counselor before she arrived, and she wanted soldiers nearing a decision about reenlisting to know whom to talk to about their options.
The commander had played " Grand Theft Auto 2 " and backed the idea, Wolfer told the outlet. Wolfer, a gamer herself, went to basic training the same week "Grand Theft Auto V" came out.

Staff Sgt. Floyd Maxwell, a network systems and communications specialist, signed up for three more years. He told the outlet his father, who died a few months ago, had encouraged him to make a career of the Army. He said the battalion had also given him a sense of family.

"The excitement from this incentive has sparked positive conversations amongst Soldiers to discuss the continuation of their service in the Army," the Army said in a statement. The service said it recognized the 3rd Infantry Division as its top division for retention in 2025.
MIAMI HEAT FINALLY UNVEIL 'GRAND THEFT AUTO VI'-THEMED JERSEYS AND SOCIAL MEDIA IS LOVING THEM

The game has an Army connection of its own. One of its main characters, Jason Duval, served in the Army before going to work for drug runners in the Florida Keys, according to Rockstar Games. Wolfer had a suggestion for the studio, too. She wants it to put Rocky the Bulldog, the 3rd Infantry Division’s mascot, in the game.
"Grand Theft Auto VI" had already brought in an estimated $1.65 billion from more than 17 million preorders by Wednesday, Forbes reported, citing market research firm Sensor Tower.

Hours before the U.S. launch, PlayStation warned that a network disruption could make it difficult for some players to launch games or access online features.
Its status page showed the issue was resolved by 2:30 p.m. ET, Axios reported. Rockstar says the game unlocks at midnight local time Thursday on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

articles.headline: Littler shocked by brilliant Wattimena at Grand Slam
keyFacts: Defending champion Luke Littler was eliminated from the Grand Slam of Darts after a 10-8 loss to Jermaine Wattimena.
Wattimena secured his spot in the quarter-finals by hitting ten 180s and maintaining an average of 101.70 throughout the match.
Wattimena will face Kevin Doets in the next round of the tournament.
body: - Published
Defending champion Luke Littler suffered a shock early exit at the Grand Slam of Darts after a stunning display from Jermaine Wattimena.
The Dutchman was in tears after securing a remarkable, and thoroughly deserved, 10-8 victory in the second round in Wolverhampton.

Having looked imperious as he won six legs on the spin to take a 7-2 lead, 16th seed Wattimena showed signs of nerves as the finish line approached, but dug in to stave off a late Littler comeback and progress to the quarter-finals.
"I think I played really incredible, I played my best game on this stage and I'm really proud of it," an emotional Wattimena told Sky Sports.
"He started playing well at the end. Last leg, [I had] one dart for the match - amazing."

Wattimena finished with an average of 101.70 having hit a staggering 10 180s and, such was his level for the majority of the match, he might feel the margin of victory should have been more comfortable.
The 38-year-old twice threatened nine-darters and had two darts for an 8-2 lead, with Littler rarely even given a look at a double.
However, the 19-year-old world champion sensed an opportunity and showed his class with a 10-darter to break throw as Wattimena finally stuttered a leg from victory.
But a dramatic comeback fell just short as, with Littler waiting to pounce on 65, Wattimena hit tops to take out 77 for the match and reach the last eight of the tournament for a second time.
Wattimena will face compatriot Kevin Doets in the next round after the world number 23 saw off Scotland's Cameron Menzies 10-5.
Doets averaged 101.51 and matched Wattimena's 10 maximums as his relentless scoring made up for an off night on the doubles.
Fourth seed Gerwyn Price is also through after a clinical display to beat Englishman Ryan Searle 10-7.
The Welshman averaged 103.31 and hit 45% of his doubles to see off 13th seed Searle, who himself averaged just under 100.
Price will face Niko Springer for a place in the semi-finals after he overcame former world champion Rob Cross 10-8.
Cross averaged 96.05 to Springer's 88.59, but the German's finishing was far superior - with a checkout rate of 48% - and that proved the difference.

articles.headline: Can You Romance Mandy In GTA 6?
keyFacts: Players cannot romance the character Mandy in Grand Theft Auto 6 despite her repeated attempts to flirt with the protagonist Jason.
Jason remains focused on his relationship with Lucia and refuses all of Mandy's romantic advances during the Pipework mission.
Returning to Mandy's home later in the game results in her telling the player to leave, with no further interactions available.
body: There are plenty of memorable moments from the first few hours of the story in Grand Theft Auto 6. From rescuing a friend at a gang hideout to reliving Lucia's run-in with the law, the story certainly isn't dull at any point. However, perhaps the mission that players will remember the most from the opening hours of GTA 6 is "Pipework."

This mission requires you to collect rent money from some of Brian Heder's tenants in Key Lento. One of those tenants is a woman named Mandy, and it's crystal clear from the get-go that she's romantically interested in Jason. So, this begs the question: can you romance Mandy in GTA 6?
Is Mandy romanceable in GTA 6?

While all of the signs point to Mandy being a romance option for Jason in GTA 6, she is actually not able to be romanced whatsoever. This is despite Mandy's best efforts, like when she changes into an extremely skimpy bikini while Jason is fixing her sink.

Throughout your dialogue with Mandy, Jason is never able to steer the conversation in a romantic way. While Mandy will continually flirt with Jason, it appears that Jason is dead-set on making things right with Lucia at this point in the game.

At the end of your time with Mandy, which comes after you fix her sink by removing a curious item that was clogging the pipes, she'll make one last-ditch effort to get Jason to stay. However, once again, Jason refuses, and you have zero control over the situation or whether Jason stays or not.

While you'll eventually have to leave Mandy to progress the Pipework mission, that doesn't mean you can't return to her at a later point in GTA 6. However, even if you return to Mandy's home, she won't be in the mood for any kind of romance. Returning to her home finds her crying in front of the TV, and if she spots you, she'll tell you to go away, as Jason has seemingly broken her heart.

Beyond this, there are no further interactions with Mandy in GTA 6, even if you decide not to pursue a romantic relationship with Lucia when she gets out of prison. Speaking of which, if you want to find out about actual romance options in GTA 6 and how to get Jason and Lucia together , take a look at our other guide. We've also covered whether Jason and Lucia can go on dates together if you're in the mood for some more romance.

articles.headline: MLB commissioner Manfred cites fan support for salary cap as baseball heads towards lockout
keyFacts: MLB commissioner Rob Manfred stated that owners will not negotiate a new labor deal without a salary cap and floor.
Players have rejected the salary cap proposal, creating a potential lockout that could halt all trades and signings after December 1.
The current collective bargaining agreement expires on December 1, and a lockout could threaten the 2027 baseball season.
body: MLB commissioner, Rob Manfred, has insisted owners will not budge from their demand for a salary cap, leaving the league on track for a lockout starting 2 December that could threaten the 2027 season.

“I can’t imagine the owners ratifying a deal that does not include a cap and floor,” Manfred said on Wednesday at a news conference during an owners meeting. Players say they will never accept a cap. The last time management proposed a cap in 1994, it led to a strike that lasted almost eight months and caused the cancellation of the World Series for the first time in 90 years.

“There’s plenty of room for compromise, but there’s one thing that I will not compromise and that’s the issue that we’re hearing from the vast majority of our fans: They want a salary cap and floor and on that we will not compromise,” Manfred continued. “We are not prepared to tell 70% of our fans that they’re wrong on this issue. Competitive balance is a serious problem, and it needs to be addressed and it’s one that we can’t avoid just because the negotiation may be difficult.”

Baseball’s five-year collective bargaining agreement expires at 11.59pm EST on 1 December. A lockout, which would be the sport’s 10th work stoppage since 1972, would bring to a halt all trades and signings.

“A decision on a lockout is one that we’re going to make at the last possible moment,” Manfred said. ”We’re going to devote ourselves to the bargaining process. I’m not that big on Thanksgiving as a holiday. We’ll make ourselves available whenever and wherever to bargain in an effort to make an agreement.”

MLB proposed the sport adopt a hard salary cap of $258.2m for 2028 and a floor of $180.2m, using luxury tax payrolls with average annual values. A team would be allowed to remain as low as 90% of the floor in 2028, which would be $162.18m, but would have to spend the entire amount of the floor over a three-year period.

Individual contracts would also be capped under the plan, which MLB says includes a 50-50 split of revenue. The union takes issue with management’s definition of revenue and expenses. Players have called the salary cap a “non-starter.”

“We made the proposal way back in May. Another word for ‘non-starter’ over months is a refusal to bargain,” Manfred said. “I think it’s time that the MLBPA realize that this proposal is serious. I’m not suggesting they need to accept it whole cloth. I think they need to look at the proposal and try to find some ways to move to the middle as opposed to making no proposal at all.”

Players proposed a “competitive integrity tax” that would penalize teams dropping below a payroll floor. They also asked for a rise in the luxury tax threshold and increased salary arbitration rights.

“The MLBPA wants more and its proposals undermine, further undermine the competitive quality of our game,” Manfred said. “What has the MLBPA done? They’ve engaged in a lot of rhetoric. They’ve characterized our proposals as not real or not serious. They’ve criticized and mischaracterized aspects of the cap and floor system in an effort to promote player opposition.

“What the MLBPA has not done is made any meaningful effort to move towards us. They have not made a significant economic proposal since their opening proposal. Indeed, there’s a paucity of responses even on topics that do not directly impact our economics.”

articles.headline: GTA 6's Japanese version only partially obscures male nudity by putting Jason in a thong, seemingly due to regional censorship
keyFacts: Players in Japan report that male characters in GTA 6 wear black thongs to obscure nudity during scenes that are fully nude in other regions.

Additional regional differences in the Japanese version of GTA 6 may be discovered as players progress further through the game.
body: GTA 6 is slowly rolling out across the globe. The crime epic's already available to play in countries such as South Korea and New Zealand, but Japanese players are finding out that male nudity is only partially obscured by a thin black thong that covers Jason and the other men in Leonida.

Last week, we reported that GTA 6 might have been censored in Japan since the region's age rating board lacked any mention of the "sexual content" we knew it would include elsewhere. The Japanese version's install size was also notably smaller than other places in the world.

Now that GTA 6 is finally in the hands of players, we have a better idea of what was left out and/or covered up in Japan. Multiple social media accounts playing the game in Japan have reported that when you take main man Jason into the shower, his butt is only kinda covered up by a thong. At least in the version I played, Jason is usually fully naked while washing up.

Another social media post spots a different male NPC wearing a very similar black thong during a cutscene that normally has him laid bare in international versions of the game. I'm guessing all instances of male nudity might be obscured similarly in GTA 6's Japanese version.

GTA 6 is far from the only game that's dealt with regional censorship in Japan, however. Baldur's Gate 3 and The Witcher 3 had their most salacious scenes censored in some manner, for example. Our Chris Tapsell still had a cracking time with the epic open worlder. "A game of opposites and awe, minute detail and impossible scale, Rockstar pushes back the horizon of video games once again with GTA 6. An irreducible mix of silliness, intimacy, grand ideas and rock 'n' roll action - and a load more after that," he wrote in Eurogamer's GTA 6 review.

articles.headline: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
keyFacts: Fashion designer Karl Kani created a streetwear brand in the late 1980s to reflect the style and culture of hip-hop artists.
Kani dressed prominent musicians including Tupac Shakur, Aaliyah, and The Notorious B.I.G. while building an international fashion business.
Kani reflects on his career, business decisions, and the rise of his brand in his new memoir titled Karl Kani: A Life By Design.
body: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
Fashion designer Karl Kani believes hip-hop needed its own clothing brand, one that reflected the music, culture and style of the artists who were changing fashion in the 1990s.

"Hip-hop needed the clothing brand that fit that look, who was from the culture," Kani told NPR's A Martínez on Morning Edition. "And I felt like the marriage between Kani and hip-hop was, like, heaven-sent."

Kani, born Carl Williams, started designing clothing in Brooklyn, New York, in the late 1980s. He was inspired by watching his father, a Haitian tailor, make matching linen suits to sell around the neighborhood.

At the time, hip-hop artists were already wearing names like Ralph Lauren, Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein. But they weren't necessarily wearing the clothes as their designers intended. They favored oversized fits, mixed colors and created looks of their own.

Kani understood the appeal. He began making clothes as a self-taught designer in Brooklyn, New York, in the late 1980s. He helped turn that emerging streetwear style into a brand worn by some of hip-hop's biggest stars, including Tupac Shakur, Aaliyah and The Notorious B.I.G.
But the designer's ambitions extended beyond dressing famous musicians. He wanted to build an international fashion business that could last.
In his new memoir, Karl Kani: A Life By Design, Kani reflects on the creative instincts and business decisions that helped his brand survive long after the decade that made it famous.
Even his name reflects his ambitions. Kani, pronounced like "Can I?," came from the doubts he faced while building his business.

"Can I really come from the inner city and build a clothing brand?" he recalled asking himself. "I didn't know the answer to that question, but I knew if I call myself Kani, then every day I have to answer that question. Yes, I can."
After more than three decades in fashion, Kani also has some thoughts about what hasn't aged quite so gracefully: men in skinny jeans.
"I feel like a lot of guys kind of messed up when the skinny jeans phase came in," he said.
His advice? "Keep it simple, keep it slick and all black. You can never go wrong in all black."
In his conversation with NPR's A Martínez, Kani discusses his new memoir, the rise of his streetwear empire, hip-hop's influence on fashion and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.
